sources.entry: HomeRec - Lightweight native macOS app for recording system audio as high-quality WAV files using ScreenCaptureKit.

summary.one_liner: Home Rec is a free, Apache 2.0-licensed native macOS app that records system audio (or a single app or a microphone) to lossless WAV, FLAC, or M4A files using ScreenCaptureKit.
summary.what_it_does: Captures whatever the Mac plays through ScreenCaptureKit, without virtual audio drivers, and can instead record one app or a microphone. Audio is normalised to 48 kHz 32-bit float stereo before encoding, then written as 16-bit PCM WAV, 24-bit FLAC, or AAC M4A at 256 kbps. Recording can run from a menu bar popover with a decibel-scaled live waveform, with the main window closed. The WAV header is rewritten about every 0.7s so a force-quit still leaves a playable file. A Recover Recordings feature repairs interrupted takes, and stream failures finalize the partial file. The README also covers diagnostics export, a disk-space guard, and a configurable save location that defaults to Desktop.
use_cases: Record system audio on a Mac
Capture meeting or call audio playing on the computer
Record a USB or built-in microphone to WAV
Save voice memos or screen-recording audio as lossless files
Recover a recording after a crash or force-quit
how_to_run: Press Cmd+R in Xcode to build and run
notable: Uses ScreenCaptureKit for system audio, so no virtual audio drivers or kernel extensions are needed
Crash-safe WAV: header rewritten about every 0.7s so partial files stay playable
Recover Recordings finds interrupted takes and repairs them with atomic writes
Single-app and microphone capture sources, remembered between launches
Always-dark glass interface that ignores the macOS light/dark setting
caveats: Requires the Screen Recording permission, which macOS applies even for audio-only capture
Microphone and system audio cannot be recorded into the same file
MP3 export is not yet supported, and a FLAC file interrupted by a crash cannot be played until repaired
Test coverage is described as a work in progress
keywords: capture what i hear on mac
